descriptionHtml:
HP Victus 15-fa1038ne Gaming Laptop - Intel Core i7-13700H - RTX 3050 6GB - 16GB RAM

Empower your gaming and professional multi-tasking experience with the HP Victus 15-fa1038ne gaming laptop, proudly offered by Turbo Computer Egypt. Driven by the high-tier 13th Gen Intel Core i7 processor and paired with the upgraded 6GB NVIDIA RTX 3050 graphics panel, this machine is meticulously engineered to maintain optimal thermal efficiency during intensive rendering, coding, or competitive esports sessions. Backed by official local warranty coverage across Egypt.
